name: agentic-pipelines
description: Multi-agent planner -> tool-caller -> critic pipeline over RAG, SQL, web search & image QA. Guardrails, tool-use memory, hybrid retrieval, evaluation automation, and a Gradio app. LangChain / AutoGen.

paragraphs: Orchestrated multi-agent workflows — a planner → tool-caller → critic loop — over real tools (FAISS/Milvus vector retrieval, SQL, web search, image QA), with guardrails, tool-use memory, observation summarization, event-driven triggering, and evaluation automation.
Runs and is fully tested offline with a deterministic brain (no API key, no model downloads); real LLMs (OpenAI / local transformers) and semantic embeddings plug in via config.
features: Multi-agent orchestration — planner, tool-caller, and critic exchange typed
Pydantic contracts (Plan, Step, Observation, Critique, RunResult), not free text, under step + wall-clock budgets.
Tools — FAISS document retrieval (Milvus-ready), read-only SQL analytics,
DuckDuckGo web search, and image analysis/QA. Each tool fails soft (never crashes a run).
Bring your own data — upload PDF / TXT / DOCX documents (added to the FAISS
